{{Top|leg}}
'''Combat thrusters''' were modifications to a starship's engines and [[Maneuvering jet/Legends|maneuvering thrusters]] that increased its ability in combat. It made the starship much quicker and able to dodge incoming fire. They were often used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and blockade runners.
